description: This file defines the PromiseInterface within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, outlining the structure and behaviors of promise objects used for managing asynchronous operations in GuzzleHTTP client. It specifies constants for promise states and methods for chaining, resolving, rejecting, canceling, and waiting on promises.

classes.name: PromiseInterface
classes.description: Interface specifying the contract for promise objects representing asynchronous operation results.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection handler, returning a new promise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise if possible.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to complete and optionally unwraps the result.
